import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
print(w.work_id.duplicated().sum(), w.year.isna().sum(), (w.year<1876).sum())
w=w.dropna(subset=['year']).copy()
w['late']=w.year>=1876; w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
print(pd.crosstab(w.genre,w.late)); print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); gs={k:v for k,v in w.groupby(['genre','late'])}
bs=[est(pd.concat([v.sample(len(v),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for v in gs.values()])) for _ in range(1000)]
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc, est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o, est(w[w.origin==o]))
print(est(w[(w.year>=1856)&(w.year<1896)]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet'); m=p[p.passage_id.isin(w[w.late&(w[c]>0)].sample(50,random_state=1).passage_ids.explode()) if False else p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))]
print(len(m)); print(m.merge(w[['work_id','year']]).sort_values('confidence').tail(8)[['passage_id','year','technology_named']])
